constraints.description: Top-down video with the paper and hands in frame. Frames are sampled at 1 fps, at most 90 frames; longer videos are subsampled evenly.

instructions:
1. Start from R0 (flat square): flat; single layer; square shape. [CLM-01]
2. Fold to R1 (book-folded rectangle): rectangular shape; folded in half. The paper is folded in half along a central axis to create a rectangular shape. [CLM-02][CLM-07]
3. Fold to R2 (diagonal-folded triangle): triangular shape; folded along diagonal; flat. The rectangle is folded along its diagonal to form a triangle. [CLM-03][CLM-08]
4. Fold to R3 (square base): compact diamond; multiple layers. The corners are folded toward the center to collapse the triangle into a compact diamond. [CLM-04][CLM-09]
5. Fold to R4 (kite form): arrowhead shape; taller than wide; taller-than-wide; yellow paper visible. The side edges of the square base are folded inward toward the center crease. [CLM-05][CLM-10]
6. Stop at R4 (kite form) and hold it to the camera. [CLM-05][CLM-06]
title: Fold a crane up to the bird base
